$comment: Test people for the local foundation test copy only (M0.7). These addresses and passwords exist only in the throwaway local stack on 127.0.0.1 and are recreated from this file on every fresh copy. They are not real accounts and must never be used anywhere else. Authenticator secrets are generated by local Auth at enrolment and kept in the ignored tmp/foundation-e2e/state.json.

visitor.description: Signed out. No account; browses the public showroom.

invitedMember.description: Registered through the invitation-only sign-up gate and confirmed the email from the mail catcher. Not identity-verified. Invitation closed after sign-up, so it can never become staff.

verifiedMember.description: Registered like the invited member, then identity accepted by the admin, phone and area confirmed, posting terms accepted. Owns the seeded showroom posts.

moderator.description: Staff role moderator, granted by the admin through a trusted local SQL step, with an authenticator app. Approves the seeded posts.

admin.description: Owner-setup invitation claimed by verifying an authenticator app, exactly as production's first administrators were set up. Reviews identity.

uninvited.description: Never registered: proves the sign-up gate refuses addresses without an invitation.
